objective: Speak with the Redridge Herbalist, Martie Jainrose.

description: Before you go back to Darcy, can you bring her some flowers for me?  You can get them at the herbalist shop back in Lakeshire, at the west end of town.
But when you get the flowers...don't tell the herbalist, Martie, whom they're from, or whom they're for...
completion: You need a bouquet of flowers? You haven't been in town very long...have you already found for yourself a sweetheart here?
I know I shouldn't pry, but it's nice to see that love is in the air... especially in dangerous times like these.
